result:
Inspected all five new stills before judging. Desktop not re-reviewed (stated unchanged).

## Verdict

**ADMIT_FOR_OWNER_PREVIEW**

## Prior blockers — resolved

- **Rectangular join gone.** In `phone-full-joined.png`, `phone-return-final.png` and `phone-closing-tracking.png` I cannot locate a horizontal edge; the burst and halftone carry through the join continuously.
- **Plate now tracks the camera.** `phone-icons-final.png` shows a single vanishing point and one continuous ray scale across the whole stage at peak. The doubled ray field and un-zoomed surround are gone.
- **Return settles correctly.** `phone-return-final.png` shows the complete `LAiDIES` with the i restored, vivid and fully saturated — not the earlier mid-morph `LA·DIES` flash frame.
- **Both bookends now visually evidenced.** Opening and closing tracking bars render as real scanline + rolling-bar passes. The closing bar sits above the wordmark and leaves the full name unobscured.

## Judged independently: the broader fade

I did not take the "peripheral vocabulary is background" framing on trust. On phone the eight ring words (PROMPT, INFERENCE, MODEL, REWIND, CONTEXT, MEMORY, AGENT) sit at roughly half strength against the original's fully vivid ring. That is a genuine reduction — but it now falls off **radially and evenly**, where the previous version faded only top and bottom, which read as an error. The centre brush glyphs and the underline stay fully opaque and vivid, and the i→cassette transformation — the only icon transformation I can actually see in any frame — is at centre and untouched. So the loss reads as a deliberate depth treatment rather than a defect. Acceptable; desktop retains the full-strength ring regardless.

## Remaining item to fix (not blocking preview)

`phone-opening-tracking.png`: the dial-up panel's chrome and its text fade at the same rate, so for the last fraction of the fade the panel box disappears while "Dialling up to SUNNYVAiLE…" and "CONNECTED · SUNNYVAiLE" survive as loose ghost text floating over the ident's word ring — two status strings with no container on top of the brand frame. The video cuts to full opacity at t=1.1 while the dial fades to t≈1.16; closing that overlap (finish the dial by 1.1, or delay the video reveal to 1.16) removes it.

## Optional taste

At phone peak, roughly half the stage is near-flat purple with little comic detail — an unavoidable consequence of pushing a plate 1.55× on a tall portrait stage. It is coherent, just quiet compared to the desktop peak. If you want it denser, scale the plate at a lower factor than the video (e.g. 1.25 against 1.55) to hold more halftone in the surround.

## Evidence limitations

Stills only; I did not play the sequence, so nothing above is a playback observation. Motion smoothness, the tracking bar's travel, and the exact dial fade timing are inferred from single frames and code, not seen. I did not verify original.mp4 byte-identity — outside what images can show. Sol's admission had no bearing on this call.
